title: Silent Wake — Classic (EXCON)
description: Classic GM-driven exercise. One trainer (GM view), one trainee (CO). 3 turns with manual/automatic injects and ETBOL PT/RT split.

content.briefing: You are the Commanding Officer of a Frigate on independent transit to patrol sector Alpha-3. NLT 112000B arrival. Transit time approx. 6 hrs at planned speed 15 kts. Regional posture: heightened readiness. ROE: Weapons Tight. Intelligence indicates possible hostile naval presence in theatre. No escort assigned.
objectives: Maintain mission tempo through escalating anomalies
Identify and respond to AIS spoofing and sensor discrepancies
rules: ROE: Weapons Tight — do not engage unless positively identified as hostile and authorised.
Select up to 2 blue cards per turn.

events.title: Turn 1 — In Transit
events.description: Transit proceeding as planned. All systems nominal. No contacts of concern. EMCON: Navigation radar only.

events.title: Turn 2 — Subtle Anomalies
events.description: Speed discrepancy detected. Ghost AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo or ESM emissions.

events.title: Turn 3 — Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
events.description: Faulty speed component identified (ETBOL 5 min). AIS traffic density increasing beyond expected baseline.

issues.title: Transit — All Systems Nominal
issues.description: All systems Green. NAV RADAR, IBMS/INS, COMMS ON. Weapons OFF.

issues.title: Speed Discrepancy + Ghost AIS Contact
issues.description: SOG vs STW mismatch. AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo.

decision_templates.title: Turn 1 — Choose your actions
decision_templates.description: Transit proceeding as planned. Systems nominal. Select up to 2 cards.

options.label: Continue Mission
options.description: Maintain current course, speed, and posture.

decision_templates.title: Turn 2 — Choose your actions
decision_templates.description: Speed discrepancy detected. Ghost AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm. Select up to 2 cards.

options.label: Start Investigation
options.description: Task crew to investigate speed discrepancy and ghost contact.

turns.title: In Transit
turns.facilitator_prompt: Transit proceeding as planned. Deliver the inject and let the trainee respond. Baseline turn — establish rhythm.

turns.title: Subtle Anomalies
turns.facilitator_prompt: Introduce speed discrepancy and ghost AIS contact. This is a MANUAL inject — trigger it when ready. Gauge whether the trainee treats this as routine or begins investigating.

turns.title: Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
turns.facilitator_prompt: Faulty speed component identified with 5-min ETBOL. AIS traffic density rising. Watch whether the trainee repairs or presses on.
